## TemplateEngine.\_processMapBlocks() method

Transforms `<map>` blocks into JavaScript array map expressions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processMapBlocks(template: string): string;
```

**Returns:**

string

The template with `<map>` blocks converted to map expressions

## Remarks

This internal method converts `<map>` blocks into array mapping operations. The `src` attribute specifies which data key contains the array. Inside the block, `{{e}}` refers to the current element, `{{e.prop}}` to element properties, and `{{i}}` to the current index. The `join` attribute specifies the separator.

## Example


```typescript
const template = '<map src="items" join=", "> - {{e.name}} ({{i}})</map>';
const processed = TemplateEngine._processMapBlocks(template);
// Result: '${(data && data["items"] || []).map((e, i) => ` - ${e.name} (${i})`).join(", ")}'
```
